name.es: Flecha rectificada de 8 mm (eje de polea loca)
name.fr: Arbre rectifié de 8 mm (axe de galet)
name.pt: Eixo retificado de 8 mm (eixo de polia louca)

description.en: A plain round shaft of 8 mm diameter, ground to g6 and cut to length: the axle of a 608 idler. One end sits in a host's 8 mm bore (a bracket's through-bore); a 608 bearing's inner ring rides on the shaft beside the host, so the bearing and the pulley pressed onto its outer ring turn while the shaft stands still.
description.es: Una flecha redonda lisa de 8 mm de diámetro, rectificada a g6 y cortada a medida: el eje de una polea loca con rodamiento 608. Un extremo asienta en un barreno de 8 mm de la pieza anfitriona (el barreno pasante de un soporte); el anillo interior de un 608 monta sobre la flecha junto al anfitrión, de modo que el rodamiento y la polea montada en su anillo exterior giran mientras la flecha queda fija.
description.fr: Un arbre rond lisse de 8 mm de diamètre, rectifié en g6 et coupé à longueur : l'axe d'un galet sur roulement 608. Une extrémité se loge dans l'alésage de 8 mm d'une pièce hôte (l'alésage traversant d'un support) ; la bague intérieure d'un 608 se monte sur l'arbre à côté de l'hôte, si bien que le roulement et la poulie montée sur sa bague extérieure tournent tandis que l'arbre reste fixe.
description.pt: Um eixo redondo liso de 8 mm de diâmetro, retificado em g6 e cortado à medida: o eixo de uma polia louca com rolamento 608. Uma extremidade assenta no furo de 8 mm de uma peça hospedeira (o furo passante de um suporte); o anel interior de um 608 monta-se no eixo ao lado do hospedeiro, de modo que o rolamento e a polia montada no seu anel exterior giram enquanto o eixo fica fixo.

governing.designation: MISUMI SFJ / PSFJ straight linear shaft, D 8 g6 (L 20–800 mm)

sources.title: MISUMI linear shafts, high accuracy, standard type — straight (SFJ / SSFJ / PSFJ / PSSFJ), catalog p. 91
sources.supports: D 8: tolerance g6, −0.005/−0.014 mm; L 20–800 mm in 1 mm increments; SFJ / PSFJ SUJ2 58 HRC and up (PSFJ hard-chrome plated)

sources.title: ISO 7089 / DIN 125 A plain washer, size 8, 8.4 × 16 × 1.6 (product datasheet 52708984)
sources.supports: ISO 7089 size 8 (M8): d1 8.4 mm, d2 16 mm, thickness s 1.6 mm

sources.title: SKF 608 deep groove ball bearing (distributor listing)

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A, on the shaft axis. +z runs along the axis to end face B at z = length_mm; +x is an arbitrary radial reference (the shaft is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry). End A goes into the host: the host's bore face sits at z = host_depth_mm. Beyond it come the gap (bearing_gap_mm, where a washer or spacer sits), the 608's face A, and its face B at z = host_depth_mm + bearing_gap_mm + 7. Both interface normals point −z, toward end A: the side on which each partner's material lies.

bearing_608_width.note: the 608's width; bearing_journal sits this far past the bearing's face A, at its face B

washer_m8_thickness.note: ISO 7089 size 8 (8.4 × 16 × 1.6); the default of bearing_gap_mm

parameters.note: MISUMI's configurable range and increment. The default, the shortest length, is a catalog convention. No frame reads it: keep host_depth_mm + bearing_gap_mm + 7 ≤ length_mm, or the bearing overhangs end B.

A convention, not a sourced fact: how far end A sits inside the host's bore, measured from end A to the host face the bearing side faces. Set it to the host's bore length for end A flush with the far face; the default 8 is the web thickness of the commons roller-bracket at its defaults.

A convention: the axial gap between the host face and the 608's face A, where a washer or spacer bears on the inner ring so the outer ring and the pulley clear the host. The default is the thickness of one ISO 7089 size-8 washer (1.6 mm, cited).

interfaces.note: Male: end A goes into the host's bore. The origin is where the host's face (the face the bearing side looks at) crosses the axis; the normal points −z, into the host, so a bore framed at that face with its normal out of the cavity (female) takes the shaft end A first.

Male: the shaft passes through the 608's inner ring. The origin is where the bearing's face B lands (bearing-608.bore is framed at face B, normal +z), 7 mm (the 608's width) past its face A; the normal points −z, so the bearing lies between the origin and the host and its face A, the side a pulley seated face-A-flush presents, looks at the host across bearing_gap_mm.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-D lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Retention is not modelled: a real stack holds the shaft in the host by a press or clamp fit, a set screw or a shaft collar, and the bearing on the shaft by a collar or a retaining ring; those vary per design and are not catalog facts. An M8 bolt is not this key: its thread is not a g6 ground diameter.
